listing.name: Knights Hospitaller - Unique Luddic Church Quest, Ship, Questline
listing.summary: Adds a unique Fleet, unique Invictus + Luddic Church Questline that leads to acquiring the Invictus of the Knights Hospitaller.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a Luddic humanitarian order questline, a unique Invictus flagship, and a Buffalo-derived support destroyer.

description:
"Knights Hospitaller" adds a Luddic humanitarian order to the Sector: the Knights Hospitaller, white-cloaked battlefield rescuers centered around the Abundant Mercy, a unique Invictus stationed over Gilead. Meet the Order of the Hospitaller at Kanta's Den, seek out Knight-Surgeon Gabriel Malachi at Gilead, and undertake a Great Labor worthy of Ludd. In this fun-for-all ages, Luddic-oriented experience, John Starsector is sure to teach Luddic children K-12 everywhere all about God’s love and purpose for our lives in the Persean Sector.

Download Here

The Abundant Mercy

Unique Knights Hospitaller Invictus

Spoiler

Codex:

Once a specialized crisis response nexus for the Domain, by its own records the Atlantis was one of hundreds of thousands of support ships intended to project the Domain of Man’s soft power upon the Milky Way Galaxy. This pristine medical nexus was discovered by salvagers cruising through normal space crewless, by itself into Hegemony-controlled space circa Cycle 190. None were on board the massive vessel, the only sounds upon the ship were the whirring of automated systems conducting maintenance repairs upon the ships system. Yet eyewitness accounts swore that upon entry into the bridge section of the lifeless, yet busy dreadnought, several systems seemed to go dark, unmanned screens and self-typing keyboards going dead one after the other until the last screen at the helm, where the captain of the Atlantis must once have stood, went dead forever.

As a matter of good will, and perhaps to rid themselves of a troublesome derelict hulk, the Hegemony soon transferred the Atlantis to the fleets of the Knights of Ludd, where it became the newly christened Abundant Mercy, headquarters of the newly founded Order of the Knights Hospitaller. Faithful to God, Ludd and Man, the Knights Hospitallar now undergo mission after saving mission, plunging themselves into the many conflicts in the Sector and saving the unrepentant, the undeserving and the unfaithful alike. After every conflict, the automated rescue shuttles of the Abundant Mercy shoot out like so many saving angels, securing floating escape pods, cutting into twisted bulkheads with trapped souls and bringing physical salvation to both friend and foe alike.

This ethos of universal charity has earned them nearly equally universal respect, from even the most cutthroat of Tri-Tachyon managers to the most witless and cruel of pirates. For all know if you come across the white-cloaked saviors of the Knights Hospitallar, you have found a rare spring of mercy within this despondent place in the stars.

Changes

Unique Invictus variantNamed flagship: Abundant MercyBuilt-in Recovery ShuttlesBuilt-in Gethsemane Rescue BaySide missile ports removed and replaced with +2 fighter baysFront ballistic mounts replaced with composite mountsGethsemane Rescue Bay reduces fleetwide crew and fighter casualties by 80%Unique dialogue and Great Labor reward path

[close]

Rapid Dragon

Buffalo-derived military support destroyer

Spoiler

Codex:

A derived class, based on the Buffalo freighter. This ship has been up-armored and refitted to better fit Domain Armada military standards while maintaining relatively civilian-capable systems and procurement costs.

Originally conceived as a low-cost, high-volume support ship for the Domain Armada, this idea eventually produced a platform capable of deploying long-range, guided weapons modules, typically guided missiles, from relatively combat-survivable freighters that were also capable of logistics support. First developed by Altair Exotech, this limited run of Buffalos formed a support core capable of rapidly deploying into battle to serve as capable reinforcements, but sans the logistical footprint that traditionally handicaps aspiring fleet commanders from fielding too many combat-only ships within their fleet.

The base hull of this destroyer is a standard Buffalo-class freighter; however, due to the pre-Collapse ship blueprint modification, this specialized Buffalo is more commonly known by its project name, the ""Rapid Dragon"".

Though the Domain collapsed before the design could see widespread deployment, the blueprint found a second wind in the post-Collapse era. Recently resurfacing in the Persean Sector, this limited run of specialized Buffalos has been eagerly adopted and refitted to the rugged standards of the Knights of Ludd. For aspiring fleet commanders navigating a violent modern Sector where dedicated combat hulls are a luxury, the Rapid Dragon fulfills a vital, desperate need: fielding heavy fire support without the crushing logistical footprint that so often leaves an expedition stranded in the dark.

Changes

Buffalo-derived combat support shipFlare Launcher replaced with Burn Drive+400 armor over baselineBuilt-in Auxiliary ThrustersAdditional ballistic mountStandard loadout included

[close]

Events and Dialogue

Spoiler

Kanta's Den bar encounter introducing the Knights HospitallerThe Abundant Mercy fleet orbits GileadKnight-Surgeon Gabriel Malachi serves as the fleet commanderDialogue reacts to Luddic quest progress

[close][close]

But Why?

Starsector needs good Christian mods. Also: unique Invictus. Sometimes the best brick is the medicinal one.

What is the intended balance of the mod?

Vanilla+. The Abundant Mercy is powerful and unique, but tied to a narrative path rather than normal acquisition. The Gethsemane Rescue Bay is fundamentally QoL in nature. However like one of my favorite ships the Maellus from Knights of Ludd, it has 4 large missile slots at the front (but lacks the capital ship built-in SO) so there's only so bad it could, while I firmly believe that this is at least way weaker than the Invictus (LP). The Rapid Dragon is meant to be a useful support hull without replacing dedicated warships, it's mostly there to add variety to missile/fighter builds.

Hard vanilla fights should still be hard fights.

aiDescription: Introduces the Knights Hospitaller, a Luddic order centered around the unique Invictus Abundant Mercy. Players can undertake a Great Labor questline to join the order and acquire the ship. The mod also adds the Rapid Dragon, a modified Buffalo support destroyer, along with new dialogue and events.
